record.title: microduck-imu-to-dxl
record.why: Connector count on the board is CANNOT DETERMINE. It matters: an XL330 has exactly two bus connectors, so a linear daisy chain can only branch at a device with three or more — the wiring lane puts the head/left-leg/right-leg branch at this board and says so.
record.origin_why: No vendor document describes this board; the record is what Pollen's published source and device tree let one say (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md).
